name: Firewall Rules
description: Firewall rules must be explicitly defined and active.

name: System Logging
description: Centralized logging must be enabled for all critical systems.

name: Backup Configuration
description: Automated backups must be configured and verified regularly.

name: Network Segmentation
description: Network segments must be isolated to limit lateral movement.

name: Remote Access Restriction
description: Remote access must be restricted to authorized personnel only.
